sn35.242:1.1: evaṃ me sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kimbilāyaṃ viharati gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre.
sn35.242:1.2: addasā kho bhagavā mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānaṃ.
sn35.242:1.4: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, amuṃ mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānanti?
sn35.242:1.6: evaṃ vutte āyasmā kimbilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.242:1.9: idha kimbila bhikkhu aññataraṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati.
